1A.title: Tile the plaza
1A.lede: Change n, m and a, then step through the rounded-up division. Hatched squares hang over the edge.

263A.title: Walk the 1 to the centre
263A.lede: Pick any cell for the 1, then step through the neighbouring row and column swaps.

405A.title: Flip the gravity
405A.lede: Play to tip the box to the right: every layer of cubes slides over, which sorts the columns. Shuffle for new ones.

1791D.title: Scrub the split
1791D.lede: Not solved yet in the log; this shows the prefix and suffix idea. Lit letters are the distinct ones on each side of the split.
